<thought>Based on the observed isotope pattern—a relatively strong M+2 peak (~33% of the base peak) together with a smaller M+1 peak (~16%)—the pattern is characteristic of the presence of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl). No other element shows a distinctive pattern of this magnitude in the data, so chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
